title: Sigils (Elements)
description: Sigil = central core of the glyph; defines the element. SVG in viewBox '-50 -50 100 100', stroke in currentColor, no fill unless noted. Shapes are consistent stylizations (not exact manga copies) intended for rendering and recognition.

sigils.name: Fire
sigils.description: Fire/heat element. Light is technically a variant of fire.

sigils.name: Earth
sigils.centerHint: Horizontal bar with a stem; inverted triangle below, with two side dots (·▽·).

sigils.name: Wind
sigils.description: Directs air. Basis of wind spells.

sigils.name: Light
sigils.description: Technically a variant of fire, distinct enough for its own category.
sigils.centerHint: 8-ray asterisk with a small central diamond.

sigils.name: Wind Underfoot
sigils.description: Wind variant used in the Sylph Shoes (float above the ground).
sigils.reference: Sylph Shoes Seal, Pegasus Carriage Spell

sigils.name: Aeriforms
sigils.description: Maintains/creates air (vs. only directing it). Keeps the Great Hall's mist; used in 'make air'.
sigils.centerHint: Wind variant with an extra loop (sustains air).

sigils.name: Whorling Wind
sigils.description: Wind variant similar but not identical; used in the Pegasus Carriage.

sigils.name: Crystal
sigils.description: Crystal sigil. Can replace earth in ribbon spells (theoretical Crystal Ribbon) and generates shards (Crystal Shard).

sigils.name: Repetition (as sigil)
sigils.description: The repetition sign can occupy the center as a sigil (Repetition Seal family). Reverts objects to their original state.
sigils.centerHint: Spiral with a vertical line through it.
sigils.reference: Repetition Seal, Serpent's Bed of Sand

sigils.name: Vision (as sigil)
sigils.description: The vision sign at the center (needs no elemental sigil). Basis of Gathering Shadows and Cloak Spell.

sigils.name: Billowing (as sigil)
sigils.description: The billowing sign at the center converts material into a cloud (Billowing Collection).

sigils.name: Unknown / Forbidden Sigil
sigils.description: Placeholder for unidentified sigils (Beast Repellent center, Forbidden Flames, Scalewolf Curse, etc.).
sigils.centerHint: Unknown — rendered as a neutral mark.
